name: dev.workers.yashil.pagetext-mcp/pagetext
title: PageText
description: Pay-per-call web, AI and blockchain tools: page to Markdown, DNS, FX, summaries, wallet balances.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Web page to Markdown: fetch any public URL and return its main readable content as clean Markdown (reader mode), plus title, description and word count. Ideal for LLM context and RAG. Not charged if the page cannot be fetched. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Website metadata / link preview: title, description, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, canonical URL, language, favicon, image, author, published date, RSS feeds and H1/H2 headings of any public URL. Not charged on fetch errors. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

tools.name: links
tools.description: Extract all links from a web page: absolute URLs with anchor text, internal/external and nofollow flags, de-duplicated (up to 500). Useful for crawling, sitemaps and link audits. Not charged on fetch errors. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS lookup: resolve A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, SRV or CAA records for any domain over encrypted DNS (Cloudflare 1.1.1.1), with TTLs, status (NOERROR/NXDOMAIN) and DNSSEC validation flag. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: whois
tools.description: Domain WHOIS (RDAP) lookup: registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC for any domain, from the official registry RDAP service. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: fx
tools.description: Currency exchange rates and conversion: latest official European Central Bank reference rates for ~30 fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, SEK, ...). Convert an amount from one currency to one or more others. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

from.description: ISO 4217 code to convert from, e.g. USD

tools.name: balance
tools.description: Wallet balance: native coin balance plus USDC/USDT (or any ERC-20 tokens you list) for an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Also returns nonce (transaction count) and whether the address is a contract. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tokens.description: Comma-separated token contracts or shortcuts usdc,usdt (default: the chain's USDC/USDT)

tools.name: token
tools.description: ERC-20 token info: name, symbol, decimals and total supply of any token contract on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: tx
tools.description: Transaction status and details on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain: success/failed/pending, block, time, confirmations, from/to, value, fee, and decoded ERC-20/NFT token transfers with symbols and amounts. Use it to verify a payment. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: gas
tools.description: Live gas prices across chains in one call: gas price, base fee and priority fee (gwei), latest block, and the cost of a plain transfer, for Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon PoS, BNB Smart Chain, Avalanche C-Chain. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: ens
tools.description: ENS and Basenames lookup: resolve a name (vitalik.eth, jesse.base.eth) to its address, or an address to its verified primary ENS name and Basename. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402).

name.description: Name to resolve, e.g. vitalik.eth or jesse.base.eth

address.description: Or: address (0x...) to find its primary names

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: AI summary of any public web page: fetches the URL, extracts the readable text and returns a concise Markdown summary (short, medium or long) in the page's language. Not charged on fetch or AI errors. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a question about a web page: fetches the URL and answers from the page content only (answer is null when the page does not say). Good for pulling one fact out of a page. Not charged on fetch or AI errors. Price: $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public web page

tools.name: translate
tools.description: AI translation of text into any language (Swedish, German, Spanish, Chinese, Persian, ...), keeping meaning, tone, names, numbers and formatting. Up to 4000 characters per call. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402).

to.description: Target language name or code, e.g. Swedish or sv

tools.name: chat
tools.description: One-shot AI chat completion (Google Gemma 4 26B): send a prompt and optional system instruction, get the answer. Up to 2000 characters in and about 800 tokens out. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402).

tools.name: image
tools.description: AI image generation from a text prompt (FLUX.1 schnell, 1024x1024 JPEG returned as a base64 data URL). Sexual or graphic prompts are refused and not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402).
